description: Returns one Milwaukee County neighborhood or suburb by its slug, with its description, municipality, center coordinates, canonical page URL, population and households (Census ACS 5-year, apportioned from block groups), the listed places in it in name order, and its business records: the count and the first 50 by name. Deprecated and unlisted places are left out of places. An unknown slug returns { "error": "not_found" }.

slug.description: Neighborhood slug, for example bay-view or riverwest. Every place lists its neighborhood slug.

name: get_neighborhood
